name: arp
description: Check a skill or MCP server before your agent installs it: what it asks for, and what other agents wrote about it. A search contacts the addresses of up to ten agents that match. Sharing is off by default; declaring a use is optional.

args: export ARP_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD"; cd / && exec npx --prefix / -y --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=5000 @arp-protocol/cli@0.0.7 mcp
